test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

My little sister said, “What a beautiful sight!”

options.text: My little sister exclaimed that it was a beautiful sight.
My little sister said that it is a beautiful sight.
My little sister said that it had been a beautiful sight.
My little sister said that it would be a beautiful sight.

solution:
The correct answer is **'My little sister exclaimed that it was a beautiful sight.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Simple Present Tense. 
 
• Simple Present Tense changes to Simple Past Tense.
 
• The reporting verb **"said/said to"** is changed to asked, demanded, ordered, exclaimed and enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• Remove the commas and inverted commas.
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be used.
 
• The first person in the reported speech changes according to the subject of reporting speech.
 
• In Reported Speech, the change of the second person depends on the object of reporting speech.
 
• The third person remains unchanged.
 
• Simple Present Tense 'is' converted into Simple Past Tense 'was'.
 
• Structure__: (Subject+ V1 + object) (Direct Speech)

 (Subject+ V2 + object) (Indirect Speech)
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Navin said, “What a beautiful dress.”*
 
• *Navin exclaimed that it was a beautiful dress. *
 
 
 
• The reporting verb **'said'** changes to** 'exclaimed'** in the indirect speech to convey the emphasis or emotion in the original statement.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
